'''Skytroopers''' were a droid branch of Zakuul [[Eternal Empire military|military]], composed of multiple [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] lines.

==Description==
Manufactured in various [[Factory/Legends|factories]] of the [[Eternal Empire]], skytroopers had several humanoid and tripod lines. All models were quipped with [[Rocket booster/Legends|rocket boosters]], allowing them to be deployed "from the sky" - hence the name. This was especially useful on [[Zakuul]], where flight allowed them to quickly move between various platforms and passages of the city. However, the droids could not stay in the air for long enough, and upon deployment stayed on the ground.<ref name="kotfe 3" /> In addition, a series of [[Sky Turret]]s - flying [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]] - were often deployed alongside ground troops.<ref name="kotfe 10">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=10}}</ref>

===Humanoid skytroopers===
[[File:Skytroopers_firing.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Skytrooper attack squad]]
Humanoid skytroopers were ergonomic mass-deployed droids, equipped with various portable weaponry, such as [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] or [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. [[Rocket booster/Legends|Rocket boosters]] were integrated into droids' backs, and a small flashlight was attached to their heads, for work in dark environments, such as the [[Endless Swamp]]s of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="kotfe 4" />

Lines of humanoid skytroopers included:

* ''Standard Skytrooper'', the most common, silver-colored variation of skytrooper, with black visors. Served as light infantry and were deployed in packs to overwhelm in numbers.<ref name="kotfe 3" />

* ''Rocket Skytrooper'', a dark-grey variety of the standard one.<ref name="kotet 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=1}}</ref>

* [[Elite Skytrooper|''Elite Skytrooper'']], advanced series of skytoopers with black reinforced [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and red visors. They served the role of [[Officer/Legends|officers]], engaging enemy by themselves, if need be. They were assigned unique individual designations, typically starting with "Z" or "ZEM".<ref name="kotfe 3" />

* [[Siege Skytrooper|''Siege Skytrooper'']], a rare variety of skytrooper with offset [[Rocket booster/Legends|rocket boosters]], black reinforced [[Armor/Legends|armor plating]] and red mono-visors. Equipped with a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] mounted to their left arm, these units were strong enough to take on enemy [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].<ref name="kotet 8">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=8}}</ref>

* ''Recon Skytrooper'', a full black rare model of skytrooper with a unique head design and four red visors. They were deployed on [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] by Commander [[Tassar (Human)|Tassar]].<ref name="Rakata Uprising">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=uprising|Landing Party}}</ref>

When skytrooper army became part of the [[Eternal Alliance]], units were repainted in gold colors.<ref name="Iokath" />
===Tripods===
Tripod skytroopers, referred to as ''skytrooper battledroids'', were three-legged heavy armored droids, with a similar design to battledroids of [[Voss (species)|Voss]]. Droids had prolonged heads mounted into the body, to which [[Rocket booster/Legends|rocket boosters]] were attached from below, and two arm-[[Blaster cannon/Legends|cannons]] protected by "shoulder" plates from above. The plating was covered in gold patterns and [[Zakuul]] emblems. Two known varieties existed, a light one with silver armor and blue visors,<ref name="kotfe 3" /> and a dark one, with dark-grey armor and green visors.<ref name="Nathema" />
==History==
By the time of the [[Eternal Empire conquest|Eternal conquest]] of [[3636 BBY|3636]]-[[3631 BBY]]<ref name="Date Conquest">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref>, skytroopers replaced the majority of organic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in [[Zakuul]]'s [[Eternal Empire military|military]].<ref name="kotfe 4">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=4}}</ref> The conquest lead to a significant expansion of droids' production, with new factories being constructed on the conquered planets such as [[Darvannis|Darvanis]],<ref name="kotfe 14" /> as well as aboard [[Star Fortress|space stations]] deployed in orbit of the subdued worlds.<ref name="Star Fortress" />

After the fall of the [[Eternal Empire]] and the rise of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in its place, Head of Science [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb|Dr. Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] accessed the [[Overwatch]] control center on [[Zakuul]] to reprogram the entirety of the Skytrooper forces. While some stayed on Zakuul for rebuilding and humanitarian work, most were immediately sent to [[Odessen]], the Alliance capital.<ref name="kotet 9" /> From here, the Eternal Alliance would rapidly grow, and the Skytroopers spread across its territory for law enforcement, military matters, and countless other tasks just as they did under the Eternal Empire.<ref name="Iokath" /> However, some skytroopers were reprogramed by the [[Order of Zildrog]] and used to defend the Order's operations on [[Nathema]].<ref name="Nathema" />
